The peptides used in this protocol are sourced from specialty peptide distributors that perform Certificate of Analysis (COA) testing on every lot to confirm identity, purity, and concentration, and that operate under the regulatory and quality standards applicable to their industry. They have not been evaluated by the FDA for the diagnosis, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease, and we treat their use as investigational and as part of an individualized wellness plan.
